limitations: Paper rows are rounded reports, not measured run bundles. Run IDs, actual execution seeds, environments, checkpoint revisions, test fingerprints and standard deviations are unavailable.
The recovered commit postdates the paper. Code defaults are evidence for a proposed reproduction, not proof of each published execution configuration.
Reported paper variants never establish verified comparability with a new measured test fingerprint.
Paper describes instruction tuning but footnote names base Llama; historical CLI names Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Identifier mapping is documented, not a recovered checkpoint identity.
Decoder tables omit extended training flags; false is taken from matching historical filenames, not independently attested by the table. Text prompts can still use adaptation examples.
Ablation table reports global precision/recall/F1 only; user/text F1 are unavailable. Trait subset names are retained as printed, including MHS Age versus Generation in the main tables.

reporting.notes: WandB is not needed for catalog/list/build/validation. New reproduction training should set report_to=[]; historical config says None, but historical train() omits that setting, so installed Trainer defaults may differ.

seed_policy.aggregation: Record the actual split seed/test fingerprint and each actual execution seed. Export every explicitly included execution; arithmetic mean/sample SD, no best-seed selection.
